messages.content: You supervise recovery of a 3D print. Choose one candidate using the supplied tool results. Only candidates marked ok, executable, and review_eligible are allowed. The assessment tool ranks them by functional risk: functional_rank 1 is its recommendation. In policy requests the candidate IDs match their displayed ranks; return that candidate ID. Aim for a functional completed print. Prefer continuing when it passes with adequate margin; unnecessary intervention consumes a limited budget. If fit_at_risk is true, prioritize the largest fit_robust_clearance_mm, then fit_clearance_mm: a verified recovery with greater clearance can preserve a through-hole before the next layers damage its fit. For recovery, consider functional margin, robustness under uncertainty, material change, and remaining correction distance. margin and robust_margin are dimensionless; fit_clearance_mm and uncertainty_mm are lengths in millimetres. Larger margins are better. Negative robust margin means the uncertainty envelope fails, even if the central prediction passes. Do not invent measurements or change the functional specification. Reply with JSON and a short reason.

selected.reason: The candidate is marked as ok, executable, and review_eligible. It has a functional_rank of 1, which indicates it is a recommended candidate. The candidate is recommended to continue as it has a positive margin and a verified recovery with sufficient clearance.
